[POETICAL SCIENCE]{.eyebrow}

## Rigour with imagination.

I am a data scientist, educator, and consultant based in Cambridge, England. My work spans the full lifecycle of applied machine learning and research analytics — from framing the right question to deploying models that inform real decisions.

At [Analytical Engine Data, Ltd.](about.qmd) I lead consulting engagements across higher education, healthcare, government, finance, and insurance. At the [University of Cambridge](resume.qmd) I teach courses in programming, statistics, machine learning, and reproducible research.

I hold a Ph.D. in Educational Leadership & Policy Analysis from Cambridge, a Juris Doctor from the University of London, and a B.A. in History from Oxford.
